info.description:
A lightweight local mock of the OpenAI REST API, covering Chat Completions
(including streaming, tool calls, and multimodal content), Embeddings, Images,
Audio, Models, Files, and Batch. Response shapes track the official OpenAI
OpenAPI spec vendored at openai.yml; see memory.md for known deviations.
info.title: Mock OpenAI API

post.description: Generates audio from the input text. Returns a fixed mock audio payload with a content-type matching the requested response_format.
Transcribes audio into the input language. response_format controls the reply shape: json (default), text, srt, vtt, or verbose_json.

parameters.description: json, text, srt, vtt, or verbose_json
parameters.name: response_format

post.description: Translates audio into English. response_format controls the reply shape: json (default), text, srt, vtt, or verbose_json.

parameters.description: json, text, srt, vtt, or verbose_json
parameters.name: response_format

post.description: Creates and runs a batch job against a previously uploaded input file. Unlike the real API, batches in this mock complete synchronously and are ready by the time the create call returns.
Cancels an in-progress batch. In this mock, batches already complete synchronously on creation, so the batch is returned unchanged.

get.description: Lists chat completions previously created and stored by this mock server.

post.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation. Supports streaming (SSE), tool/function calling, and multimodal content parts.

get.description: Retrieves a stored chat completion by id.

post.description: Modifies metadata on a stored chat completion. Only the `metadata` field can be updated, per the real API.

delete.description: Deletes a stored chat completion by id.

get.description: Lists the request messages plus the generated assistant reply for a stored chat completion.

post.description: Creates a completion for the deprecated /v1/completions endpoint. Always returns a fixed mock response for model "gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct".
Creates an embedding vector representing the input text.

get.description: Returns a list of files, optionally filtered by purpose.

parameters.description: Only return files with this purpose
parameters.name: purpose

post.description: Uploads a file that can be used across various endpoints (assistants, batch, fine-tune, vision, user_data, evals).

parameters.description: assistants, batch, fine-tune, vision, user_data, or evals
parameters.name: purpose

get.description: Returns information about a specific file.

post.description: Creates an edited or extended image given an original image and a prompt.
Creates an image given a text prompt.
Creates a variation of a given image.

parameters.description: Image to use as the basis for the variation
parameters.name: image

get.description: Lists the model ids this mock recognizes. Note: chat/embeddings/images/audio endpoints accept any model string, not just these.
Retrieves a single model by id, if it's one of the ids returned by List models.

tool_call_id.description: tool-role messages: which call this responds to

tool_choice.description: oneOf "none"|"auto"|"required"|{type,function}; documented as object, see openai.yml for the full union

status.description: deprecated in the real API, but required; always "processed" here

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token auth. Any non-empty token is accepted unless API_KEY is configured (see README). Example: "Bearer sk-mock".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
